This update featured the [[DJ Booth]] rework and multiple optimizations. This update encompassed seven versions, the main v1.29.0 update (released 28 August 2024), and six minor updates, the v1.29.1 (released 28 August 2024), v1.29.2 (released 28 August 2024), v1.29.3 (released 28 August 2024), v1.29.4 (released 28 August 2024), v1.29.5 (released 29 August 2024) and v1.29.6 (released 29 August 2024). ==Additions== *[[Settings#DJ|DJ]] Sound Setting ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[DJ Booth]] reworked. **Now has a selection of tracks, which provide different buffs to towers. ***Changing tracks has a 15 second cooldown. **Changing music now makes the new music start at the time mark the previous ended on. **Now mutes all other music when player's camera is close to it. **Updated range visuals. **Placement footprint size increased from 1.5 to 2.5. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|600}} to {{Money|1,200}}. ****Range decreased from 15 to 12. ****[[Range Buff]] increased from 10% to 12.5%, but is now only active if the purple track is selected. ****[[Discount Buff]] increased from 0% to 5%, but is now only active if the green track is selected. ***'''Level 1''' ****Range increased from +2 to +3. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|850}} to {{Money|1,250}}. ****[[Range Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|10% > 15%|+5%}} to {{Tooltip|12.5% > 15%|+2.5%}}. ****[[Discount Buff]] changed from 0% to {{Tooltip|5% > 7.5%|+2.5%}}. ****Unlocks a red track which provides a 10% [[Damage Buff]]. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|2,500}} to {{Money|3,000}}. ****[[Range Buff]] changed from 15% to {{Tooltip|15% > 17.5%|+2.5%}}. ****[[Discount Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|0% > 10%|+10%}} to {{Tooltip|7.5% > 10%|+2.5%}}. ****[[Damage Buff]] increase of {{Tooltip|10% > 12.5%|+2.5%}} added. ****''Drop the Beat'' ability added, with a 30s cooldown. ****Purple track ''Drop the Beat'' ability added: *****Three pulses added. *****1.5 cooldown for pulses added. *****Applies knockback and slowdown to enemies. *****Knockback force of 20 added. *****Base slowness of 20% added. *****Slowness per tower of 1% added. *****Max slowness of 40% added. ****Green track ''Drop the Beat'' ability added: *****Base cash of {{Money|250}} added. *****Cash per tower of {{Money|35}} added. *****Max cash of {{Money|600}} added. ****Red track ''Drop the Beat'' ability added: *****Three pulses added. *****1.5 cooldown for pulses added. *****Damage increased from +0 to +15. *****Lead detection added. *****Base defense drop of 5% added. *****Defense drop per tower of 1% added. *****Max defense drop of 25% added. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|4,000}} to {{Money|8,000}}. ****Range increased from +0 to +1.5. ****[[Range Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|15% > 25%|+10%}} to {{Tooltip|17.5% > 22.5%|+5%}}. ****Knockback force increase of +2.5 added. ****Max hits increase of +1 added. ****Slowness time change of 6 > 8 added. ****[[Discount Buff]] changed from 10% to {{Tooltip|10% > 12.5%|+2.5%}}. ****Base cash increase of {{Money|250}} > {{Money|500}} added. ****Cash per tower increase of {{Money|35}} > {{Money|50}} added. ****Max cash increase of {{Money|600}} > {{Money|1,250}} added. ****[[Damage Buff]] increase of {{Tooltip|12.5% > 15%|+2.5%}} added. ****Damage increased from +0 to +10. *****Base defense drop change of 5% > 7% added. ***'''Level 5''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|9,000}} to {{Money|20,000}}. ****Now applies all buffs even if the track is not active, but it does not have the full buff power. *****Purple track [[Range Buff]] when inactive is 12.5%. *****Green track [[Discount Buff]] when inactive is 7.5%. *****Red track [[Damage Buff]] when inactive is 10%. ****[[Range Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|25% > 35%|+10%}} to {{Tooltip|22.5% > 25%|+2.5%}}. ****Knockback force decrease of -2.5 added. ****Max hits increase of +1 added. ****Slowness time change of 8 > 10 added. ****Base slowness increase of 20% > 30% added. ****Max slowness increase of 40% > 50% added. ****Pulses increased from +0 to +1. ****[[Discount Buff]] changed from {{Tooltip|10% > 20%|+10%}} to {{Tooltip|12.5% > 15%|+2.5%}}. ****Base cash increase of {{Money|500}} > {{Money|750}} added. ****Cash per tower increase of {{Money|50}} > {{Money|75}} added. ****Max cash increase of {{Money|1,250}} > {{Money|2,250}} added. ****[[Damage Buff]] increase of {{Tooltip|15% > 20%|+5%}} added. ****Damage increased from +0 to +25. *****Base defense drop change of 7% > 10% added. *Updated [[Matchmaking]] UI when playing through the ''PLAY SURVIVAL'' button. **First menu shows three mode types, [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, survival and special modes. **Second menu, if available, shows the available modes. **Third menu shows the available player counts. *Optimized UI rendering for lobby and shop. *Optimized rendering for the player list. *Optimized culling for tower pets and nametags. *Optimized tower pets. *Disabled statue collisions. *2D richtext no longer updates. *In the mode vote, [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode no longer has a "''[NEW]''" text under it. *Fixed towers not receiving buffs if they were placed at a high height. Tower passive buffs now will ignore tower height. *Fixed using [[Time Scale]] before other players joined, now when another player joins it will be set to 1x. *Fixed [[Time Scale]] making time jump forward if set to 0x for a few seconds, and then set to a different speed. *Fixed the [[Ace Pilot]] being upside down in the [[Daily Store]]. *Fixed [[Matchmaking]] not showing icons for towers when a match has been found. :In '''v1.29.1''': *Version number changed from '''v1.29.0''' to '''v1.29.1'''. :In '''v1.29.2''': *Version number changed from '''v1.29.1''' to '''v1.29.2'''. :In '''v1.29.3''': *Fixed all event crates and the [[Lovely Crate]] not appearing in the inventory. :In '''v1.29.4''': *Version number changed from '''v1.29.3''' to '''v1.29.4'''. :In '''v1.29.5''': *Fixed ''Undead Solider'' counting triumphs in any mode for its final objective. *Partially fixed [[Mission Quests]] and [[Quests]] objectives sometimes not tracking the requirements correctly. :In '''v1.29.6''': *Fixed [[Mission Quests]] and [[Quests]] objectives sometimes not tracking the requirements correctly. :In '''v1.29.7''': *Fixed [[DJ Booth]] slowing down [[Boss]] enemies. *Fixed sold towers still boosting the strength of the [[DJ Booth]]'s ''Drop the Beat'' ability. ==Official Update Trailer== [[File:DJ Tower Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|thumb|750px|center]] ==Gallery== {{Gallery|Open = Yes| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} DJREWORKTHUMB.png {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} DJREWORKICON.png {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} DJBoothThumbnailClean.png }} ==Official Update Log== ''NOTE: Not everything here will be accurate, as this is transcribed from the in-game update log.
